### The Missing Middle

Game Changer, the podcast by TWS Partners, May 2026. Why childcare allocation in Germany is still mostly uncoordinated despite well-understood theory, and what municipalities need to run matching procedures.

[Listen ↗](https://tws-gamechanger.libsyn.com/the-missing-middle-how-market-design-gets-built-for-the-public-sector-with-thilo-klein){.more}

### How are school places allocated?

ZEW podcast, September 2026, in German. On early tracking and what academic-track schools do for children from less privileged families, with secondary school pupils from Mannheim.

[Listen ↗](https://www.zew.de/en/zew/news/how-are-school-places-allocated){.more}
